rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records for the entire import is within 0.1% threshold.
Checks that all currency exchange rate values are non-negative (historical pre-redenomination hyperinflation rates < 5e-6 round to 0.0 at 5 decimal places).
Checks that every currency exchange rate StatVar resolves to at least 1 place.
Ensure every currency series has strictly positive MaxValue (> 0) and all non-redenominated currencies have strictly positive MinValue (> 0).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinValue, MaxValue FROM stats

rules.description: Ensure active major currencies (EUR, INR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY) have fresh monthly LocalCurrency MaxDate (>= 2026-01) and active annual StandardizedCurrency series have MaxDate >= 2025.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '_ToCurrency_(EUR|INR|GBP|JPY|CAD|AUD|CHF|CNY)$') OR (StatVar LIKE 'StandardizedCurrency_%' AND NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '_ToCurrency_(YUN|CSK|NIO)$'))
params.condition: (StatVar LIKE 'LocalCurrency_%' AND MaxDate >= '2026-01') OR (StatVar LIKE 'StandardizedCurrency_%' AND MaxDate >= '2025')
